Import packages
```{r include = TRUE, message=FALSE, eval = FALSE}
library(dartR)
library(devtools)
library(adegenet)
library(hierfstat)
library(PopGenReport)
library(pegas)
library(ape)
library(ggplot2)
library(diveRsity)
library(dplyr)
library(poppr)
library(StAMPP)
library(genepop)
library(reshape)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggrepel)
library(snpR)
library(grid)
library(tibble)
```

Import data
```{r }
#Set directory
setwd("~/Desktop/Conservation_Genomics/3_Population_Genomics/GA")

#Load genlight object
load("~/Desktop/Conservation_Genomics/1_SNP_quality_control_filtering/GA/gle_GA.rdata")
```

```{r Convert Genlight to Genind to Hierstat}

#Covert Genlight to Genind
gi <- gl2gi(glf)
save(gi, file="gi_GA.rdata")
```

```{r Weir and Cochrams Global Fst}
#Convert Genind to Hierstat file (needed for bootstrapping)
di <- genind2hierfstat(gi)
wc(di)
```

```{r Calculate confidence intervals for Weir and Cochrams Global Fst}
boot.vc(di[1], di[-1])$ci
```

```{r Calculate pairwise Fst (Weir and Cochrams)}
PairwiseFst <- pairwise.WCfst(di)

write.csv(PairwiseFst, "GA_PairwiseFst.csv")

round(PairwiseFst, 3)
```

```{r Calculate confidence intervals for Pairwise Fst (Weir and Cochrams)}
boot.ppfst(di)

write.csv(boot.ppfst(di), file="boot.ppfst(di).csv")
```

```{r Estimating Population Structure - DAPC}

#Perform a PCA to choose the number of PC in the DAPC:
input_scaled = scaleGen (gi, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE, NA.method = "mean")
pca_input = dudi.pca(input_scaled, center = TRUE, scannf = FALSE)

#% of PC variation
pc_pca = as.data.frame(pca_input$eig)
pc_pca[,2] = (pc_pca/sum(pc_pca))*100

#Rule of 100% of variance,number of PC to reach to 100% of explained variance
index_100 = length(rownames(gi@tab))-1
index_100 #173

##Visualizing K- means clustering
###Select the ’best’ BIC is often indicated by an below in the curve of BIC values as a function of k
pdf("GA_DAPC_K_means_clustering.pdf", width=7.5, height=6)
grp <- find.clusters(gi, max.n.clust=29, n.pca = index_100, stat="BIC")
#Choose the number of clusters (>=2): 2
dev.off()

#Data frame with results 
grp_df = as.data.frame(grp$Kstat)
grp_df$K = c(1:29)
colnames(grp_df) = c("BIC", "K")
grp_df

#Plot
ggplot(grp_df, aes(x = K, y = BIC)) +
  geom_line(color = "black", size = 0.25 ) +
  #geom_segment(aes(x = K, y = min, xend = K, yend = max)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 4, color = "black", fill = "#e5f5f9") +
  geom_point(data=grp_df[1, ], aes(x = K, y = BIC), shape = 21, size = 4, color = "black", fill = "#2ca25f") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 29, by = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Number of Genetic Clusters", y = "BIC") +
  theme_bw() + theme(panel.border = element_blank(), panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"))+ theme(legend.position = "none")+
  theme(legend.title=element_text(size=12, face="bold"), legend.title.align=0.5, legend.text=element_text(size=10, face="italic"), axis.line = element_line(colour = 'black', size = 1.25), axis.ticks = element_line(colour = 'black', size = 1.25),
        plot.title = element_text(color="black", size=20, face="bold.italic")) +
  ggtitle("Grevillea aquifolium")

ggsave("GA_DAPC_K_means_clustering.pdf", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r Number of clusters }
#### Choose the number of cluster (Kstat) with the lowest value
#### K=1
grp$Kstat
```

```{r Perform DAPC}
pdf("GA_DAPC_eigenvalues.pdf", width=7.5, height=6)
dapc1 <- dapc(gi, grp$grp, n.pca=173)
dev.off()
```

```{r Choosing the optimal number of PCs to retain}
pdf("GA_DAPC_optim.a.score.pdf", width=7.5, height=6)
optim.a.score(dapc1)->oa
dev.off()
```

```{r Redo DAPC}
###redo DAPC
dapc2<-dapc(gi, grp$grp,n.pca=oa$best,n.da=3)

##probability of membership
summary(dapc2)
```

```{r Visualise DAPC}

## DAPC scatter
cols2 <- funky(2)
pdf("GA_DAPC2_scatter.pdf", width=7.5, height=6)
scatter(dapc2, posi.da="bottomright", bg="white", pch=20, cell=0, cstar=0, col=cols2, solid=.4,
        cex=4,clab=0,scree.pca=TRUE,
        posi.pca="topleft")
dev.off()
```

```{r Mean allelic richness per site}

#Convert genind object into hierfstat format
gh <- genind2hierfstat(gi) #convert genind object into hierfstat format

#Calculate basic population genetic statistics for each locus
basic_gi = basic.stats(gh, diploid=TRUE)
basic_gi$overall

#Calculate summaries -across loci!- from outpuut of Hierfstat
n<-as.data.frame(basic_gi$n.ind.samp)
n_locmean<-apply(n, FUN=mean,MARGIN=2,na.rm=T)#mean across loci
n_sd<-apply(n, FUN=sd,MARGIN=2,na.rm=T)

#remove NA#
glf.imp <- gl.impute(glf, method="neighbour") 
#Warning: Population  Site_MountWE  has  239  loci with all missing values.
save(glf.imp, file="glf.imp_GA.rdata")

#Covert Genlight to Genind
gi.imp <- gl2gi(glf.imp)
save(gi.imp, file="gi.imp_GA.rdata")

Richness <- allel.rich(gi.imp, min.alleles = NULL)

Richness$alleles.sampled 
```

```{r Mean observed heterogeneity (Ho) per site}
Ho_locmean <- apply(basic_gi$Ho, MARGIN = 2, FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE) %>% round(digits = 2)

Ho_sd<-apply(basic_gi$Ho, FUN=sd,MARGIN=2,na.rm=T) %>% round(digits = 2)
```

```{r  Mean expected heterogeneity (He) per site}
Hs_locmean <- apply(basic_gi$Hs, MARGIN = 2, FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE) %>% round(digits = 2)

Hs_sd<-apply(basic_gi$Hs, FUN=sd,MARGIN=2,na.rm=T) %>% round(digits = 2)
```

```{r Visualise heterozygosity per site}

#Create data frame of site names with Ho and He and convert into long format
Het_locmean_df = data.frame(Site = names(Ho_locmean), Ho = Ho_locmean, He = Hs_locmean) %>%
  melt(id.vars = "Site")
write.csv(Het_locmean_df, file = "Het_GA_r2.csv")

custom_theme = theme(
  axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
  axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
  axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
  axis.title.x = element_blank(),
  axis.line.y = element_line(size = 0.5),
  legend.title = element_blank(),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
  panel.grid = element_blank(),
  panel.background = element_blank(),
  plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 15, face="bold")
)


# Italic label
hetlab.o = expression(italic("H")[o])
hetlab.e = expression(italic("H")[e])

ggplot(data = Het_locmean_df, aes(x = Site, y = value, fill = variable))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), colour = "black")+
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0), limits = c(0,0.50))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("royalblue", "#bdbdbd"), labels = c(hetlab.o, hetlab.e))+
  ylab("Heterozygosity")+
  ggtitle("Grevillea aquifolium")+
  custom_theme

ggsave("GA_Heterozygosity.pdf", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r Calculate inbreeding coefficient (FIS)}
Fis_locmean<-apply(basic_gi$Fis, FUN=mean,MARGIN=2,na.rm=T) %>% round(digits = 3)

Fis_sd<-apply(basic_gi$Fis, FUN=sd,MARGIN=2,na.rm=T) %>% round(digits = 3)
```

```{r Plot FIS, Ho and He}
fis = rownames_to_column(data.frame(apply(basic_gi$Fis, 2, mean, na.rm = TRUE)))
names(fis) = c("pop", "fis")

expected_het = rownames_to_column(data.frame(apply(basic_gi$Hs, 2, mean, na.rm = TRUE)))
names(expected_het) = c("pop", "exp_het")

obs_het = rownames_to_column(data.frame(apply(basic_gi$Ho, 2, mean, na.rm = TRUE)))
names(obs_het) = c("pop", "obs_het")


#Merge and write out new values

fis_he_ho = left_join(fis, expected_het)

fis_he_ho = left_join(fis_he_ho, obs_het)

write.csv(fis_he_ho, file="fis_he_ho.csv")

#read fis_he_ho with new pop names
fis_he_ho_ns <- read.csv("fis_he_ho_ns.csv")

plot(fis_he_ho_ns$exp_het~ fis_he_ho_ns$obs_het)
plot(fis_he_ho_ns$fis~fis_he_ho_ns$obs_het)
plot(fis_he_ho_ns$fis~fis_he_ho_ns$exp_het)

hetlab.o = expression(italic("H")[o])
hetlab.e = expression(italic("H")[e])

ggplot(fis_he_ho_ns, aes(exp_het, obs_het)) +
  geom_point(mapping=aes(size=fis,
                         alpha=0.5,
                         fill=fis),
             colour = "black",
             shape=21) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#4575b4", 
                       mid = "#fefcba", high = "#d73027", midpoint = 0.221) +
  scale_color_distiller(palette = "RdYlBu") +
  ylab(hetlab.o) + xlab(hetlab.e) +
  theme_test() +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = 15), 
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 15),
        legend.position="bottom", legend.box = "horizontal",
        legend.text=element_text(size=10, face="plain"), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(colour="black", 
                                   vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5, 
                                   face = "plain", size=10),
        axis.text.y = element_text(colour="black",size=10,face="plain"),) +
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(title = expression(paste("F",italic("IS"))),
                               label.position = "bottom",
                               title.position = "left", title.vjust = 0.8,
                               frame.colour = "black",
                               barwidth = 10,
                               barheight = 1.5)) +
  geom_label_repel(aes(label = pop_new),
                   color = "black", 
                   fontface = "bold",
                   segment.color = "grey30",
                   segment.size = 1,
                   min.segment.length = 0.1,
                   na.rm = TRUE,
                   show.legend = TRUE) + 
  guides(alpha="none", size = "none")

ggsave("GA.fis_he_ho.pdf", height = 6, width = 6)
```


```{r Hi Diversity from betas function in hierfstats}

#Calculate betas and extract Hi
betas<-betas(gh)
str(betas$Hi)

Hi<-as.data.frame(betas$Hi)
Hi_locmean<-apply(Hi, FUN=mean,MARGIN=1,na.rm=T)
Hi_sd<-apply(Hi, FUN=sd,MARGIN=1,na.rm=T)

#Summary table of mean across loci, per population
div_summ<-as.data.frame(cbind(n_locmean,n_sd,Ho_locmean,Ho_sd,Hs_locmean,Hs_sd,Fis_locmean,Fis_sd,Hi_locmean,Hi_sd))
str(div_summ)
div_summ$Population<-rownames(div_summ)
head(div_summ)
write.csv(div_summ, file = "GA_summary_mean_loci_pop.csv")
```

```{r Calculate the proportion of polymorphic loci per population}

write.csv(glf.imp@pop, file="GA.glf.imp@pop.csv")

pops <- read.csv("GA.glf.imp@pop.csv", header=F)

pops <- pops$V1

gi.imp@pop <- as.factor(pops) # make factor

gs <- import.snpR.data(gi.imp)

cal.poly <- calc_prop_poly(gs, c("pop"))
polymor <- get.snpR.stats(cal.poly, c("pop"), stats = "prop_poly")$weighted.means

write.csv(polymor, file="GA_prop_poly.csv")
```
